hardware.cuda: 13.0 (driver-reported runtime family; engine bundles its own CUDA libraries)

model.artifact_fingerprint: HF cache blob sha256 (verified on download); see artifact.sha256
model.quantization: NVFP4 routed experts (ModelOpt), other layers per model card
model.resident_weight_profile: all weights in unified memory (21.89 GiB loaded)

engine.name: vLLM
engine.startup_command_without_secrets: vllm serve nvidia/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-NVFP4 --served-model-name qwen3.6-35b-a3b --tensor-parallel-size 1 --trust-remote-code --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --attention-backend flashinfer --moe-backend marlin --gpu-memory-utilization 0.4 --max-model-len 262144 --max-num-seqs 4 --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 --enable-chunked-prefill --async-scheduling --enable-prefix-caching --speculative-config {method:mtp,num_speculative_tokens:3,moe_backend:triton} --reasoning-parser qwen3 --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enable-auto-tool-choice (API key via env)

notes: NVIDIA model-card recommended DGX Spark command minus --load-format fastsafetensors.
generation_config overrides sampling defaults (temperature 1.0, top_k 20, top_p 0.95) unless the request sets them; bench sends temperature 0.
